description: Distortion from Surge: a waveshaper with its own feedback loop, a parametric band and a low-pass filter before it and another pair after it.

params.text: Sets the gain of the parametric band ahead of the waveshaper, -48dB to 48dB.
Sets the centre frequency of the parametric band ahead of the waveshaper, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the bandwidth of the parametric band ahead of the waveshaper, 0 to 5 octaves.
Sets the corner of a low-pass filter ahead of the waveshaper, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the waveshaper, -24dB to 24dB.
Sets how much of the waveshaper's output is fed back into its input, -100% to 100%.
Picks the shaping curve: Soft, Hard, Asymmetric, Sine or Digital.
Sets the gain of the parametric band after the waveshaper, -48dB to 48dB.
Sets the centre frequency of the parametric band after the waveshaper, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the bandwidth of the parametric band after the waveshaper, 0 to 5 octaves.
Sets the corner of a low-pass filter after the waveshaper, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the output level of the distortion, -24dB to 24dB.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Frequency knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Bandwidth knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the High Cut knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Drive knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Feedback knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Waveshaper knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Frequency knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Bandwidth knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the High Cut knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; no parameter of the distortion can be tempo-synced.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
